item.title: Comment on Sundry observations on the Trump tariffs by Massimo
item.description:
Tariffs are ugly, but they will be phased out one day. What will remain is the enormous loss of reputation of the US, already decimated by the spiteful utterances about Greenland and Panama. Most people believe that the US is extremely powerful, but all that power has historically been used mostly for good.

This perception is shattering. Nobody can trust the US in this moment. The damage to humanity will be epochal, and I am afraid it will start pretty soon with proliferation of nuclear weapons. The post-war agreement that developed countries were not supposed to develop nukes in exchange for the US umbrella is over. I fully expect not only countries like Germany or Japan developing nuclear weapons, but also mid-tier nations under potential threat, like Poland, Finland, Korea or Taiwan.

If you are Japan or Viet Nam, I'd imagine you'd look at this and think that if the US can do it Canada their brother, in breach of their own trade deal, then trade deals with China in preference to the US, and emphasising CPTPP and ASEAN membership above bilateral deals, are going to look real good.
